items.title: Vikas Khemani on How Not to Lose Your Shirt Chasing Multibaggers
items.description: Small-caps can create extraordinary wealth — but they can also destroy capital when investors get the basics wrong. In this episode of The Wealth Formula with N Mahalakshmi, Vikas Khemani, founder and CIO of Carnelian Asset Management, shares his framework for navigating India’s small- and mid-cap universe. With 27 years of experience in capital markets, and nearly eight years managing funds, Khemani draws on his own experience to distil the lessons he has learnt from his mistakes. Watch this exclusive conversation on The Wealth Formula with N Mahalakshmi.

items.title: Kotak turns cautious on Indian IT, downgrades Infosys, TCS and LTM; prefers challengers amid AI shift
